snippet.title: Season 9: The Mystery of Thebes // Dev Vision Vol. 19 | Marvel Rivals
snippet.description:
Guangguang and Zhiyong are back again to kick off Season 9 by diving into the Mystery of Thebes! 🌟

Get ready for fresh new changes, our latest hero that'll shake up the battlefield, and a brand-new map.

📅 Season 9 begins on July 10th UTC.

Get ready to jump into the biggest update of Marvel Rivals yet!

Play free now on:

🔹 Steam: https://t.co/IPhy0Of1cG
